policy: Resolve game-facing variant semantics first; only then map to physical catalog families. Story/era labels may require semantic aliases because physical catalogs often describe the same appearance by costume role rather than game location.

The game names the appearance by story location (Jabba's Palace), while physical catalogs describe the same Return of the Jedi disguise as Skiff Guard. This is a semantic alias, not a lexical match; at least two physical Skiff Guard releases remain, so exact release still requires visual/part evidence.

systemic_finding: Game-facing story/era labels can describe the same appearance differently from physical catalogs. Semantic aliases should be explicit and narrow (for example Lando Jabba's Palace -> Skiff Guard), never inferred from loose token similarity.
